services.name: Class
services.desc: We are so excited for you to participate in our youth program! We accept registrations on a rolling basis. In order to begin the process, we ask that you complete the following registration form. - You will be asked to provide identification, proof of enrollment in school, Social Security Card, Guardian information, and a headshot/resume (we can help create one with you if you don't have one yet). - You will be asked to fill out a W9, sign a waver of photo/video use during the program, a health status questionnaire, and a pre-program assessment form. - Please come prepared to share your skills/talents with us - bring your artwork or poetry, or perform - whatever skill(s) you have, and tell

blurb: Theatre Y wants to participate in people’s lives in ways that matter, here and now.Rather than telling stories about a community, we seek to participate in our community’s story.
